info.title: Eduujoy API
info.summary: Frozen v0 contract for the Eduujoy MVP.
info.description:
Frozen v0 contract, written from PRD-API Section 7 (endpoints), Section 8 and master PRD
Sections 8-9 (shapes), and Section 9 (SSE and WebSocket events).

Rules:
- The API must stay backward compatible with this file. Additive changes go through
  the "Contract change requests" section of docs/status/api.md or docs/status/ui.md.
- The UI builds its MSW mocks from ui/docs/openapi.json (a JSON copy of this file)
  until each U slice switches to the real API (docs/EXECUTION-PLAN.md).
- JSON field names are camelCase. The snake_case shapes in master PRD Section 8 are
  internal model-output contracts; the API maps them to these DTOs.
- Auth is cookie-based (`ej_at`, `ej_rt`, HttpOnly). Unsafe methods require
  `X-Requested-With: eduujoy` and an allow-listed `Origin` (CsrfGuard).
- Every error is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457).
- CORS exposes `X-Request-Id`, `Retry-After` and `Content-Disposition` to allow-listed origins,
  so the UI can read them on cross-origin responses (Retry-After on 429 and 503;
  Content-Disposition on the data export).
- Realtime payloads (SSE and Socket.IO) are listed under `x-sse-events` and
  `x-socket-events`, and their payloads are defined in `components.schemas`.

post.summary: Register with email and password; sets session cookies.
Email and password sign-in; sets session cookies.
Clear both cookies and revoke the session.
post.description:
Public, so an expired access cookie can't block sign-out; CsrfGuard still applies. Revokes the
session found by the `ej_rt` hash and, when a valid `ej_at` is sent, the session in its `sid`.
Always answers 204 and clears both cookies, even when no session matched.

204.description: Signed out (always, including when no session matched).

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access cookie.
post.description:
Reads `ej_rt`. Reuse of a rotated token revokes the whole session family and returns 401.
A second refresh of the same token within the 10-second grace window (two tabs refreshing at
once) returns 409 `REFRESH_CONCURRENT` and leaves the cookies untouched: the other request
already rotated them, so the client replays its original request once instead of signing out.

get.summary: Start Google OAuth (authorization code with PKCE).

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Same-site path on APP_ORIGIN to land on after sign-in; unsafe or missing values fall back to /today.

parameters.name: reauth
parameters.description:
Re-authentication for a sensitive action (DELETE /v1/me). Google is asked for a fresh
sign-in (prompt=login, max_age=0), and the API counts the session as freshly signed in
only if the ID token's auth_time is within the last 10 minutes; otherwise the sign-in
succeeds but DELETE /v1/me still returns REAUTH_REQUIRED.

get.summary: OAuth callback; sets cookies and redirects to APP_ORIGIN.

302.description: Redirect back to APP_ORIGIN (with `?error=<code>` on failure).

get.summary: Session bootstrap; the UI's single source of session truth.
Download all my personal data as JSON (GDPR-level export, master PRD §12; PRD-API §12).

200.description: The export, sent as an attachment (`Content-Disposition`).

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment file name. Exposed to allow-listed origins via CORS.

delete.summary: Delete my account and personal data; signs out (clears both cookies).
delete.description:
Requires a sign-in (password or Google, not a token refresh) within the last 10 minutes.
Otherwise 401 with code `REAUTH_REQUIRED`: the client must not try a refresh for it (a
refresh keeps the original sign-in time); it asks the learner to sign in again, then retries.

204.description: Deleted and signed out; both cookies cleared.

401.description: Not signed in (`UNAUTHENTICATED`), or the sign-in is older than 10 minutes (`REAUTH_REQUIRED`).

post.summary: Resolve free text to a canonical topic or up to 3 choices (FR-01, FR-02).
post.description:
If the embedding provider is unavailable, the API falls back to a name and alias search
and returns `choices` when any are close enough; it never creates a topic during an
outage. If nothing is close, it returns 503 with Retry-After.

post.summary: Start a diagnostic for a topic; returns the first batch of 4 items (FR-03).

get.summary: Read my diagnostic so the UI can resume it after a reload (US-02).
get.description:
Owner only. `items` is the batch issued last and not answered yet (empty once completed), so a
reloaded client continues exactly where it stopped; `placement` is set once `status` is
`completed`. Another user's diagnostic answers 404, so IDs can't be probed.

200.description: The diagnostic with its outstanding batch and progress.

post.summary: Submit a batch of answers; returns the next batch or the placement (FR-04).
post.description:
Send the same optional `Idempotency-Key` on every retry of one batch. A replay with the
same key and body returns the stored 200 response and records nothing twice; the same
key with a different body returns 409 CONFLICT.

200.description: Next batch, or the final placement.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only paths with this status, for example `active` for the Today screen.

get.summary: Read one path with steps and resources.

patch.summary: Mark actions done, rate difficulty (US-08), change step status.

get.description:
Server-Sent Events. On connect the server replays every event after `Last-Event-ID`.
Event names and data payloads: `progress` → JobProgressEvent, `partial` → JobPartialEvent,
`completed` → JobCompletedEvent, `failed` → JobFailedEvent. A heartbeat comment is sent every 20 s;
the stream closes after `completed` or `failed`.

post.summary: Batch-submit every answer for a checkpoint (FR-17, FR-18).
post.description: `{id}` is the step ID that owns the checkpoint. Returns 200 if everything is auto-graded, or 202 with a jobId if any answer is open.

202.description: Open answers queued for AI grading.

post.summary: Swap a resource in a step for a similar one (US-07, FR-22).

200.description: The step with the replacement resource.

post.summary: Thumbs up or down, too easy or too hard, or a flag on a resource or step (FR-22).

get.summary: Current grid position per topic (FR-20, US-09).

post.summary: Create a Lemon Squeezy checkout link (FR-23).
post.description:
After payment, Lemon Squeezy sends the learner back to `{origin}/account?checkout=success`,
where `{origin}` is the request's allow-listed Origin. The flag is only a hint: the plan
changes when the webhook is processed (`entitlement.changed`, or `GET /v1/auth/me`).
A `subscription` checkout while a subscription is active returns 409 `CONFLICT`; credit
packs are unaffected. 503 when the payment provider is unavailable.

post.summary: Lemon Squeezy webhook; verified by HMAC in X-Signature. Exempt from CsrfGuard.

get.summary: Flagged items awaiting review (FR-24). Role reviewer or admin.

patch.summary: Resolve a review item. Role reviewer or admin.

get.summary: AI cost per pipeline stage and model (FR-25). Role admin.
Latency per pipeline stage and model (FR-25). Role admin.

503.description: Not ready (a dependency check failed). Code `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, type `/problems/not-ready`.

x-sse-events.description: Event names and data payloads on GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events.

x-socket-events.description:
Socket.IO namespace `/realtime`. The cookie is checked in the handshake; the socket joins room
`user:{id}` (and `role:reviewer`). Server → client events are listed below. Client → server messages
are limited to `ack` and `subscribe:topic`.

cookieAuth.name: ej_at
cookieAuth.description: Access JWT, 15 min. HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/.

refreshCookie.name: ej_rt
refreshCookie.description: Opaque refresh token, 30 days, rotated. HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/v1/auth.

IdempotencyKeyOptional.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyOptional.description: Optional; when sent, retries of the same request reuse it (see the operation).

ValidationError.description: Validation failed; `errors` maps to form fields.

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in or session expired (code UNAUTHENTICATED).

Forbidden.description: Not the owner or missing role (code FORBIDDEN).

RefreshConcurrent.description: The refresh token was rotated by a concurrent request; cookies are unchanged. Code `REFRESH_CONCURRENT`.

Conflict.description: Conflict, for example an idempotency key reused with a different body or an email already registered.

QuotaExceeded.description: Plan quota or credits exhausted (code QUOTA_EXCEEDED).

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying. Exposed to allow-listed origins via CORS.

BudgetExceeded.description: Daily AI budget reached for cold topics (code AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED).

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until the next UTC midnight, when the daily budget resets (at least 1). Exposed to allow-listed origins via CORS.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A dependency is briefly unavailable (code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE). Retry after the given wait.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying (30 for topic resolve). Exposed to allow-listed origins via CORS.

createNew.description: Skip matching and create a topic from `text` (after the learner rejected the choices). Subject to the daily new-topic cap (429).

TopicResolveResponse.description: `matched` (similarity at or above the server's match threshold), `choices` (at most 3, between the choice and match thresholds), or `created` (new topic). Thresholds are server-side and may be tuned.

DiagnosticResponse.description: GET /v1/diagnostics/{id}. The batch shape plus the topic and timestamps.

currentStep.description: The first step that is not done yet, so Today renders from the list alone. Null when the path is not active or every step is done.

steps.description: 6–12 generated steps, plus any inserted remedial steps.

remedialStepId.description: Set when a second fail inserted a remedial step.

nextPathJob.description: Set when `stageAdvanced` is true. The job that re-assesses the learner and builds the next stage's path (US-06); stream it from `eventsUrl`, and its `resultRef` names the new path. Absent or null otherwise.

quantity.description: Credit packs to buy (credit_pack only; 400 if sent with subscription or outside 1–10). Preset on the Lemon Squeezy checkout; credits come only from the paid order in the webhook.

resultRef.description:
Always an API path, never a bare id. Format per job kind:
- path generation and the stage-advance job (`nextPathJob`): `/v1/paths/{pathId}`, the new path.
- checkpoint grading: `/v1/checkpoints/{stepId}/submissions/{submissionId}`. An identifier only
  (v0 has no GET for it); the graded result is inline in `result`.
